summary: Ferrari N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a periodic buyback report for its Euro 250 million third tranche, part of an approximately Euro 3.5 billion multi-year program expected through 2030. Between September 7 and 11, 2026, the company repurchased 42,707 common shares for about Euro 15.0 million, averaging Euro 351.62, split between Euronext Milan and NYSE, including sell-to-cover transactions. Treasury now stands at 1,669,152 common shares, 0.94% of common shares and 0.71% of total capital. Watch execution pace against the tranche and any program expansion or EPS accretion signals.
